CA-DFDS 從固定光圈與對焦設定下的車身清晰度估測距離。在 CARLA 資料: CA-DFDS estimates vehicle distance from image sharpness with fixed aperture and focus settings. Inspect inputs, sharpness and distance estimates on existing CARLA samples.

四格共用紅車距離游標。UniDepth V2 與 Depth Pro 顯示線性校: All panels share the same red-vehicle sample. UniDepth V2 and Depth Pro distances use linear calibration; raw outputs are also shown.
逐幀絕對誤差（m）。點擊曲線可跳至對應樣本。: Absolute error per sample (m). Click the chart to seek to a sample.
四格顯示紅車樣本；深度模型距離經線性校正。影片涵蓋四種車色，共 48 張離散距離: Panels show red-vehicle samples with linearly calibrated depth models. The video contains 48 discrete samples across four vehicle colors.
對單張 f/1.4 影像套用車輛遮罩，轉換成 CIECAM02 的 J、a₍c₎: Apply a vehicle mask to a single f/1.4 image, convert it to CIECAM02 J, a₍c₎ and b₍c₎ channels, and map the standard deviation σ of the weighted Laplacian response to distance using quadratic calibration.
40 mm 鏡頭、36 mm 感光面、對焦 15 m，相機高度 0.8 m。側面: 40 mm lens, 36 mm sensor width, 15 m focus distance and 0.8 m camera height. Side and top views are schematic.
既有推論結果動畫重播，非瀏覽器即時推論。: Animated replay of existing inference outputs; inference does not run in the browser.

比較同一張紅車影像旋轉前後的輸出，並以 480 張測試集的 RMSE 檢視整體影: Compare the same red-vehicle image before and after rotation, alongside RMSE on the 480-image test set.
深度模型欄採線性校正。此實驗在影像平面旋轉 180°，車輛與相機的空間位置固定。: Depth models use linear calibration. Images are rotated by 180°; the vehicle and camera positions remain fixed.
CARLA 測試集涵蓋紅、綠、藍、黑，每車色 12 個距離 × 10 張影像。表: The CARLA test set contains red, green, blue and black vehicles: 12 distances × 10 images per color. Results are sorted by overall RMSE.
主表採手繪遮罩。近距離 1.2–3.7 m，遠距離 4.2–6.7 m。近／遠欄: The table uses annotated masks. Near range: 1.2–3.7 m; far range: 4.2–6.7 m. Near/far values are the root mean square of per-distance RMSE values. Real-vehicle validation is separate.
每種乘數使用 240 張影像，顯示 CA-DFDS 的 RMSE。: CA-DFDS RMSE on 240 images for each exposure multiplier.
各點代表一種車色。橫軸為 f/22 影像的平均紋理量。: Each point represents a vehicle color. The x-axis shows mean texture measured on f/22 images.
影片將 CARLA 離散影像依距離或車色重排。時間軸呈現資料集順序，沒有連續行駛: Videos replay discrete CARLA images ordered by distance or color. The timeline represents dataset order, not continuous driving time.
逆光與反光尚無對應量測。實體相機實驗列於後續實驗 M6。: Backlighting and reflections have not been measured. Physical-camera validation remains future work.
RTX 5080 + Intel Core Ultra 7 265K，紅消防車: RTX 5080 + Intel Core Ultra 7 265K, 30 red-firetruck images with supplied masks. FPS and median latency are reported separately from the measurement source.
超出校正範圍（7.2 m）：校正曲線只涵蓋 1–7 m，外插誤差變大。: Beyond calibration (7.2 m): the curve covers 1–7 m; extrapolation increases error.
曝光 ×0.5（偏暗）：紋理對比下降，σ 變小，距離被高估或低估。: Exposure ×0.5: lower texture contrast changes σ and introduces distance error.
曝光 ×0.7：同上，程度較輕。: Exposure ×0.7: a milder reduction in texture contrast.
曝光 ×2.0：大面積過曝，清晰度量測失準。: Exposure ×2.0: extensive overexposure distorts sharpness measurements.
上下鏡射影像（資料集 reverse）：與旋轉不同，說明見 RESULTS 補充: Vertical reflection (dataset reverse): distinct from rotation; see RESULTS supplement Q.
換車種（SUV）未重新校正：車身紋理不同，消防車的校正曲線不適用。: SUV without recalibration: different texture makes the firetruck calibration unsuitable.
換車種（SUV，第二次渲染）：同上。: SUV, second rendering: the same calibration mismatch.
遮罩錯誤：框沒框好（與手繪遮罩 IoU 0.33），清晰度混入背景，誤差變大。: Mask error (IoU 0.33 against annotation): background contamination increases distance error.
